title: Regularity extension to fully nonlinear equations

problemStatement.plain: Does the regularity theory from Hilbert's 19th problem extend to fully nonlinear equations F(D²u) = 0? What conditions on F guarantee smooth solutions?
whyMatters: Evans-Krylov theorem is the cornerstone of modern fully nonlinear PDE theory
Connects optimal control (Bellman) and differential games (Isaacs) to regularity

proven: pucciMin_le_pucciMax: M⁻(t) ≤ M⁺(t) for 0 < λ ≤ Λ
pucci_positive/pucci_negative: sign-based evaluation of Pucci operators
pucciMax_uniformly_elliptic: M⁺ is uniformly elliptic with constants (λ,Λ)
viscosity_uniqueness: viscosity sub+super on boundary implies equality
hilbert19_fully_nonlinear: main theorem for convex uniformly elliptic F
knownResults.goal: Fully nonlinear extension formalized. 11 theorems proved, 8 axioms, 1 sorry.

currentState.focus: Gallery entry created. Docker build verified.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: 503 lines, 1 sorry (classical_implies_viscosity_sub), 8 axioms for deep PDE theory. Gallery entry created. Docker build verified.
insights: Pucci operators in 1D simplify to piecewise linear: M⁺(t) = Λt if t≥0, λt if t<0
Uniform ellipticity as sandwich: λ(b-a) ≤ F(b)-F(a) ≤ Λ(b-a) for a≤b
Viscosity solutions use touching functions (C² test functions that touch from above/below)
Evans-Krylov requires convexity — Nadirashvili-Vladut counterexample shows this is essential
Bellman equations (sup of linear operators) are naturally convex → Evans-Krylov applies
Full matrix version requires SimplicialComplex-level infrastructure not in Mathlib
mathlibGaps: No viscosity solution theory in Mathlib
No Pucci extremal operators in Mathlib
No Evans-Krylov or Krylov-Safonov in Mathlib
No ABP maximum principle in Mathlib

approaches.name: 1D simplification with viscosity framework

approaches.outcome: 503 lines, 1 sorry, 8 axioms. Full regularity chain proved.
